A copper-alloy Roman trumpet brooch c. AD 75-175. The foot of the brooch is decorated with two shallowly inscribed transverse grooves running completely around it. The raised portion of the foot between these two grooves carries a number of shallow vertical grooves. There are two longitudinal grooves, one on each side of the brooch running the length of the leg from the foot to the acanthus…
